WITH weekly_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        logistics_provider,
        week_block,
        SUM(sum_bwt) / SUM(parcel_qty) AS avg_bwt
    FROM spx
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT 
        logistics_provider,
        MAX(CASE WHEN week_block = 'W1' THEN avg_bwt END) as start_bwt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN week_block = 'W5' THEN avg_bwt END) as end_bwt
    FROM weekly_metrics
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING start_bwt IS NOT NULL AND end_bwt IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    logistics_provider, 
    (end_bwt - start_bwt) AS degradation
FROM bounds
ORDER BY degradation DESC
LIMIT 1;
